Package io.milvus.bulkwriter.common.clientenum

  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    BulkFileType
    The bulk data file types supported by the Milvus BulkWriter, together with their numeric codes and file name suffixes.
    CloudStorage
    Cloud storage providers supported by the Milvus BulkWriter, together with their endpoint templates and the endpoint placeholder they replace.
    ConnectType
    The connection type used by the Milvus BulkWriter to reach the remote storage and Milvus endpoints.
    TypeSize
    Maps Milvus scalar data types to the size in bytes that each value occupies in bulk data files.
